## What's new in v2.0.47

### One "Network Map" in the menu when CleanX is also installed
With the CleanX theme installed alongside UniWRT, the UniWRT menu showed two **Network Map** entries. The second one is CleanX's own map, which only works under CleanX, so opening it showed "The Network Map is part of the CleanX theme".

UniWRT now lists only its own map when both are installed. CleanX already does the same the other way round. Nothing else changes: both themes keep their files separate, and each theme's map still shows device names you've set in the other.

### Upgrading
Run the install line below again, then reload the page.
